notes: ACCESS: rejuvenation.com 403s every Chrome curl_cffi profile (chrome107-133a all 403) but serves 200 to Safari/Firefox fingerprints - a 17-profile sweep found safari15_5/17_0/18_0, both iOS Safari and firefox133 all work; safari17_0 used throughout. Any query string (e.g. '?start=0') is 403'd by the WAF, so the WSI '?start=0' header trick is unavailable here. r.jina.ai returned jina's own Cloudflare 'Just a moment' 403 on every attempt; translate.goog gets a 403 from the origin (Google's fetcher is refused); WebFetch timed out twice at 60s; Googlebot-UA also 403. TREE: taken from the site's own department side-nav, embedded in each department page's HTML as the JSON object "ssrSideNav" (id/type/name per node, type=header for the grouping rows, type=subcat for real listings, type=linkcat for cross-department links). Pulled ssrSideNav for /shop/furniture/, /shop/outdoor/, /shop/organization/ and /shop/bath/. Every leaf URL below is also present verbatim in the site's own sitemap (netstorage/sitemaps/shop-sitemap-1.xml.gz, 800 URLs). QTY: the listing pages are client-side SPAs - the SSR HTML carries "totalProductsCount":0 and no product tiles or JSON-LD, and the grid is populated entirely from Constructor.io (ac.cnstrc.com, key_9BhS51IOFNhJejk4). Since Constructor IS the source the rendered 'N Items' header is computed from, and no rendered header was reachable by any route, every qty was taken from /browse/group_id/<id> and then INDEPENDENTLY CONFIRMED BY FULL ENUMERATION (paged to the last short page, counted unique product IDs). All 22 leaves matched exactly (total_num_results == unique-ID count) and a second spaced read reproduced all 22 numbers with zero drift. Discrimination check passed: the number changes per group (10..84) and no constant site-wide total appears. EXCLUDED - rollups / 'shop all' (§3): All Living Room Furniture (268), All Bedroom Furniture (63), All Dining Room Furniture (64), All Kitchen Furniture (13), All Home Office Furniture (47), All Outdoor Furniture (62), Shop All Furniture, All Furniture, Upholstered Furniture (all-upholstered-furniture, 207 - 196 of its 207 IDs, 95%, are inside the union of its own siblings Sofas+Sectionals+Accent Chairs+Ottomans+Sectional Components, so it is a rollup not a leaf). EXCLUDED - product-line 'collections' (§3): the Upholstered Furniture Collections node and its 13 named children (Reeseville/Eleanor/Monrowe/Luisa/Tarlow/Luanna/Monet/Roswell/Hastings/Wrenton/Sublimity/McNary/Vailer), Islington Collection, the ~55 '<Name> Furniture Collection' and '<Name> Outdoor Furniture Collection' nodes, Outdoor Furniture Collections and its 5 children, and the per-line Sectional Components pages (Roswell/Sublimity/Wrenton). EXCLUDED - facets / availability re-cuts: In-Stock & Quick Ship Furniture/Upholstery, In-Stock Bedroom/Dining/Sofas & Chairs, Drop Ship Furniture, Contract Grade, Bestsellers, New Arrivals, Sale, Dining Room Project Guide, Shop by Living Room / Dining Room, and All ADA & Accessible Furniture (6 items: 2 C-side tables, 2 outdoor dining tables, 2 power recliners - an accessibility attribute re-cut of nodes already listed). Fabric/Leather/Wood/Outdoor Upholstery Swatches excluded as material samples, not furniture. EXCLUDED - not furniture by primary product type, tiles inspected: 'All Entryway' (/shop/furniture/entryway-furniture/, 130) - the Furniture department's only Entryway child, but its tiles are overwhelmingly hook racks, wall mirrors, floor mirrors, woven baskets and wall shelves; only ~15 of 130 are consoles/sideboards/benches, so the Entryway grouping row was dropped entirely. 'Bath Furniture & Storage' (/shop/bath/bath-furniture/, 50) - linked from the Furniture department's Bath Furniture header, but the tiles are ~17 medicine cabinets, ~8 teak shower benches/seats, plus teak caddies, shelves, soap dishes, mats and hook racks; only 4 are storage cabinets, so it reads as bath accessories/fixtures (§1 excludes bathroom accessories, and the prior Home-Decor pass already excluded Medicine Cabinets as fixtures). Bath Vanities (14, all named vanity units) IS kept. Also excluded: Fire Pits & Patio Heaters (12), Patio Umbrellas & Covers (14), Outdoor Storage, Storage Baskets/Canisters & Containers/Bookshelves-Organization duplicates, and everything in Lighting / Mirrors / Rugs / Hardware / Decor. OVERLAP KEPT AND DOCUMENTED: Bookcases & Shelving (20) vs Modular Shelving & Wall Units (53) share 16 IDs - both are separately named nav nodes in different departments, both emitted, the smaller one flagged. Outdoor 'Coffee & Side Tables' (18) includes 3 furniture-cover SKUs in the site's own count; the number is the site's, left unmodified.
